info.title: Impact Management Platform API Contract
info.description: Implementation specification. Closed nested DTOs, typed dynamic maps, command receipts and resumable upload protocol. Application and lifecycle tests remain required. This file supersedes the API blueprint in Engineering Assets v1.0.

put.description: WHOLE mode only. Check current owner, tenant, byte count and SHA256; immutable first write, identical replay returns same receipt. MULTIPART mode uses numbered parts and exact completion manifest. Media max 25,000,000 bytes; imports max 100,000,000 bytes.

post.description: Seal exact ordered part manifest and whole-file digest under upload lock. Missing/changed/extra parts conflict. Freeze new parts, queue assembly and scan. Blob remains quarantined until verified CLEAN. Job generation fences stale workers.

get.description: Mediated content response. Reauthorise before stream and at bounded intervals/chunks; Range requests independently checked. No signed redirect. Current restrictions override historical access.

put.description: Owner and current tenant authority required. Part offset is (part_number-1)*1048576. Exactly one MiB except final part. Identical replay returns original receipt; different digest conflicts. Never overwrite a committed part.
